gaps.note: The bound k = O(m^{k tau}) holds only if tau > 0. The page only says to fix tau < 1 with s/W < m^tau; when s/W <= 1 that allows tau <= 0, and then m^{k tau} does not grow and the sum bound of k fails. The page needs to require 0 < tau < 1; m >= 2 alone does not give the claim.
